test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 14 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language. 'KARAN' is coded as 'OCVCR' and 'STAPLE' is coded as 'WVERPG. What is the code for JOYFUL' in the given code language?
solution:
Here, we use the table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dfacdbac68152a34d31e9292dfa81580274a6be8865d67ad4d9621b65581ce06.png] ​

**Logic: '4' and '2' are added alternatively to the positional value of the alphabet.**

'KARAN' is coded as 'OCVCR' →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/91463c6512867dc20a48b13c78160f25af7c57886dd6fdbd90f00e9a12568210.png] 

'STAPLE' is coded as 'WVERPG' →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0cc168d8f75ca1307cfbb9cdf7757194beac3414d92f59bed28d89acc6d8752f.png] 

Similarly, 'JOYFUL' will be coded as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f9ebbeb716266c58f8b494b1a0ac325364a83bd841abf832763bee193bb879e5.png] 

Here, 'JOYFUL' is coded as **'NQCHYN'.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (4)".
